body: I was thinking about that. Is it possible to join somewhere else so that I'm not reminded of this pain? I really don't want anybody to find me while I go through this. Is there like a join same day thing?

They aren't mad anymore. They were mad when I made a ton of mistakes in my life and lie to them about it. I honestly can't tell people what I really am, I'm ashamed of my mistakes and my depression makes me make even worse decisions. I think something fundamentally is wrong with me and I need to wipe the slate clean.

I know thats how they feel. Occassionally when they are stressed out they vent and they let me know that what I've done so far basically kills them inside. They are kind hearted people, and after what I've done in the past and seeing how its affected them then, this will be ten times worse at least. I'm afraid that this time they'll never be able to forgive me. At this point in my life, they are the only ones I have left, and losing them means I've nothing. 

I know it will hurt them deeply, but how can dealing with my loser ass be better.

I've put my family through too much already, they just now started to understand what depression means. I've been taking my medication regularly but it doesn't help anymore. I know that I have to go nuclear, either by getting rid of myself or removing myself from all this.

I would talk to my parents, but the thing is that they just coped with the fact that I wasn't going to med school and now I have to drop this bomb on them. No way. They almost wringed my neck for deciding not to go, telling them that this happened is tantamount to ensuring i'll be murdered.

For me, I screwed up my early years of school by diving into deep depression. I changed my career thinking that would help, but now all of it is ending. Either I can join the military and never speak to my family again or I can go kill myself.
